order_form.py
class OrderForm (Aggregate Root)
id, tenant_id, state, items, fulfillment_strategy
add_item(), remove_item()
request_payment(), process_payment()
cancel(), deliver()
total() → calcula soma + taxa

Open, Paid, Closed

request_payment(), process_payment(),
cancel(), deliver() → raise se inválido
